scope: read-only integrity and metric replay of existing saved predictions
heads: all seven stored subset heads, no selection
checks: sample IDs unique and agree among split metadata and prediction archive
train/validation/test ID sets are disjoint and have expected subject roles
saved validation logits and labels are bitwise equal to the corresponding rows in the saved full prediction archive
recompute every stored test accuracy from saved logits and test labels and compare with result.json
compute per-held-user class-macro accuracy for all seven heads and all eight folds
prohibited: fit or update any model, transform, or threshold
choose a head, fold, class, or user after inspecting outcomes
claim independent-user validation or a novel method from this archive replay
fixed_decision: record all checks and metrics; this audit can establish artifact consistency only, not a method contribution or independent generalization
outputs: aggregate metrics, structural checks, source artifact SHA-256 values; no row-level IDs or arrays copied to Git
